text:
Maya L.: Quick spot request for the post-launch inbound play: we need a micro one-pager (A4) that doubles as a webinar leave-behind and an outbound insert. Focus: benchmark sparkline, 3 micro case bullets, and a tiny 'how we route leads' key.

Ravi P.: Can we make the sparkline variants show two lines: latency improvement vs cost per token? Tiny legend only.

Maya L.: Yes, two small sparklines stacked. Copy should be micro: headline (6 words), 3 bullets (single sentence each), footer legal line.

Nina C.: Design constraints: must be print-safe (no pure RGB), single sheet double-sided, and include bleed for print. Also need a digital PNG sized 1200x628 for socials.

DesignBot: Blank template created in Figma: https://figma.com/f/redwood/micro-onepager-2026. Artboards: A4_print_ready and social_1200x628.

Ravi P.: For the routing key: four icons with short labels: AE, SDR, Ops, Legal. Colors should map to the campaign palette but keep grayscale contrast for print.

Maya L.: I'll drop the finalized copy here by noon. Nina, can you export print-ready PDFs and PNGs?

Nina C.: Yes, will export once copy and final comps locked.

DesignBot: Added export presets for PDF (CMYK) and PNG 1200x628.

Maya L.: Thanks team :rocket:
